description: Evolution de la position du trait de côte (ligne de stabilité) entre 1950 et 1978 sur 4 communes de la Réunion is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by BUREAU DE RECHERCHES GÉOLOGIQUES ET MINIÈRES. Information on the evolution of the position of the stability line shall be provided for the period 1950-1978. This reflects the changes between the positions of the stability line in 1950 and 1978. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Evolution of the position of the coastline (stability line) between 1950 and 1978 in 4 communes of Réunion" (machine-translated by the portal). The listing shows 2014-05-28 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
